title: 更新 enroll Zod schema 支援新身份證明類型
content:
POST /api/enroll 的 Zod 驗證需配合 idDocType 變更。

變更範圍（src/lib/validation/enroll.ts）：
1. idDocType 改為 enum: HKID | PASSPORT | PERMIT | OTHER
2. idDocNumber 驗證邏輯依 idDocType 分支：
   - HKID: prefix + check digit 格式（現有規則）
   - PASSPORT: alphanumeric（現有規則）
   - PERMIT: 自由文字，最少 4 字元
   - OTHER: 開頭須為 "Others: " 後接自由文字
3. 更新 enrollSchema.refine 中對 registrant members 的 idDocNumber 檢查

[待確認] PERMIT 格式驗證規則（例：8-9 字元，包含字母數字）？OTHER 是否強制 "Others:" prefix？

findings: idDocType enum added to enroll schema: HKID | PASSPORT | PERMIT | OTHER
idDocType added to registrant group member schema
Frontend sends idDocType in API payload for both individual and group enrollment

acceptance: enrollSchema accepts idDocType: HKID | PASSPORT | PERMIT | OTHER
verification: npm run typecheck && curl POST /api/enroll with each idDocType variant → appropriate 200/400
